metadata.title: Beyond the Shelf Price: A Comprehensive Economic Framework for Evaluating Laundry Detergent Value | Tide
metadata.description: Learn how to evaluate laundry detergent value using Total Cost of Use and Cost Per Effective Wash, including detergent price, energy use, re-wash costs, cleaning performance, and potential effects on garment lifespan.
